subtitles.zh: 我们首先关注本周中期选举的后续影响，以及它们可能对经济议题相关政策——或者说政策缺失——意味着什么，这些议题对选民至关重要。
subtitles.en: We start with the aftermath of the mid-term elections this week, and what they may mean for the policies or lack of policies on the economic issues that matter to voters.

subtitles.zh: 我们采访了哥伦比亚商学院的格伦·哈伯德，他曾在乔治·W·布什总统任内担任经济顾问委员会主席。
subtitles.en: We talked with Glenn Hubbard of the Columbia Business School who served as chair of the Council of Economic Advisers under President George W. Bush.

subtitles.zh: 我认为有两个信息，而媒体并没有真正捕捉到。第一，选民想要的是行之有效的方案。
subtitles.en: I think there are two messages and I don't think the press has really picked up on them. The first is that voters want what works.

subtitles.zh: 第二，选民希望你们真正关注他们的问题。
subtitles.en: The second is that voters want you to actually look at their problems.

subtitles.zh: 有一种观点认为，民主党获胜是因为他们的想法更好。
subtitles.en: I think there's a view that, well, the Democrats won because their ideas are better.

subtitles.zh: 也许是这样，也许不是，但这不是选民所表达的。
subtitles.en: Well, they may or may not be, but that's not what the electorate was saying.

subtitles.zh: 我认为选民只是在说，给我一些行之有效的东西。可负担性是一个例子，但确实几十年来经济发生了巨大变化。
subtitles.en: I think the electorate is just saying, give me something that works. Affordability is an example, but really we've had decades of big change in the economy.

subtitles.zh: 两党政客都点头称是，但并未提供解决方案。
subtitles.en: Politicians on both sides of the aisle have nodded, but have not offered solutions.

subtitles.zh: 我认为选民已经厌倦了。所以，如果民主党明天转向你，说，好吧，我们在新一届国会应该推行什么计划来解决一些可负担性担忧，
subtitles.en: And I think voters are sick of it. So, if the Democrats turned you tomorrow and said, okay, what plan should we pursue in the new Congress that would address some of the affordability concerns,

subtitles.zh: 你会建议他们关注什么？好吧，让我从三万英尺高空开始，然后再落到具体层面。
subtitles.en: what would you suggest they look at? Well, let me start 30,000 feet and then lay on the plane.

subtitles.zh: 所以，从宏观来看，我会关注两点。一是经济增长。
subtitles.en: So, 30,000 feet, and I'll be about two things. One is economic growth.

subtitles.zh: 情况依然如此。增长让生活中的一切变得更轻松，让我们更富裕。
subtitles.en: It's still the case. Growth makes everything in life easier. It makes us better off.

subtitles.zh: 但其他人有一个全面参与的经济。不要轻率地说，人工智能会让我们更富裕。
subtitles.en: But the others have a full participation economy. Don't be glib and say, AI will make us better off.

subtitles.zh: 就像全球化或任何其他技术变革一样。
subtitles.en: The same way globalization would or any other technological change.

subtitles.zh: 告诉我们如何让所有人都能参与。
subtitles.en: Tell us how we all can participate.

subtitles.zh: 我们首先关注本周中期选举的后续影响，以及它们可能对经济议题相关政策——或者说政策缺失——意味着什么，这些议题对选民至关重要。
subtitles.en: We start with the aftermath of the mid-term elections this week, and what they may mean for the policies or lack of policies on the economic issues that matter to voters.

subtitles.zh: 我们采访了哥伦比亚商学院的格伦·哈伯德，他曾在乔治·W·布什总统任内担任经济顾问委员会主席。
subtitles.en: We talked with Glenn Hubbard of the Columbia Business School who served as chair of the Council of Economic Advisers under President George W. Bush.

subtitles.zh: 我认为有两个信息，而媒体并没有真正捕捉到。第一，选民想要的是行之有效的方案。
subtitles.en: I think there are two messages and I don't think the press has really picked up on them. The first is that voters want what works.

subtitles.zh: 第二，选民希望你们真正关注他们的问题。
subtitles.en: The second is that voters want you to actually look at their problems.

subtitles.zh: 有一种观点认为，民主党获胜是因为他们的想法更好。
subtitles.en: I think there's a view that, well, the Democrats won because their ideas are better.

subtitles.zh: 也许是这样，也许不是，但这不是选民所表达的。
subtitles.en: Well, they may or may not be, but that's not what the electorate was saying.

subtitles.zh: 我认为选民只是在说，给我一些行之有效的东西。可负担性是一个例子，但确实几十年来经济发生了巨大变化。
subtitles.en: I think the electorate is just saying, give me something that works. Affordability is an example, but really we've had decades of big change in the economy.

subtitles.zh: 两党政客都点头称是，但并未提供解决方案。
subtitles.en: Politicians on both sides of the aisle have nodded, but have not offered solutions.

subtitles.zh: 我认为选民已经厌倦了。所以，如果民主党明天转向你，说，好吧，我们在新一届国会应该推行什么计划来解决一些可负担性担忧，
subtitles.en: And I think voters are sick of it. So, if the Democrats turned you tomorrow and said, okay, what plan should we pursue in the new Congress that would address some of the affordability concerns,

subtitles.zh: 你会建议他们关注什么？好吧，让我从三万英尺高空开始，然后再落到具体层面。
subtitles.en: what would you suggest they look at? Well, let me start 30,000 feet and then lay on the plane.

subtitles.zh: 所以，从宏观来看，我会关注两点。一是经济增长。
subtitles.en: So, 30,000 feet, and I'll be about two things. One is economic growth.

subtitles.zh: 情况依然如此。增长让生活中的一切变得更轻松，让我们更富裕。
subtitles.en: It's still the case. Growth makes everything in life easier. It makes us better off.

subtitles.zh: 但其他人有一个全面参与的经济。不要轻率地说，人工智能会让我们更富裕。
subtitles.en: But the others have a full participation economy. Don't be glib and say, AI will make us better off.

subtitles.zh: 就像全球化或任何其他技术变革一样。
subtitles.en: The same way globalization would or any other technological change.

subtitles.zh: 告诉我们如何让所有人都能参与。
subtitles.en: Tell us how we all can participate.
